title: Shashen Maidong decoction alleviates influenza A virus-induced lung injury by modulating ZBP1-mediated PANoptosome assembly.
authors: Xu, Mengzhen; Gong, Kai; Zhu, Jiang; Sun, Tianying; Zhu, Qingjun; Xiao, Li; Wang, Xiaolong
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药沙参麦冬汤通过调控ZBP1介导的PANoptosis减轻流感病毒肺损伤，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是细胞死亡机制与药效，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Influenza A virus (IAV) infection characteristically induces lung injury through acute inflammation and epithelial barrier breakdown. Among the pathogenic mechanisms involved, Z-DNA binding protein 1 (ZBP1)-dependent PANoptosis plays a central role. While Shashen Maidong decoction (SMD) demonstrates clinical efficacy in respiratory conditions, the molecular mechanisms by which it modulates this particular mode of cell death require further elucidation. PURPOSE: This study was designed to evaluate the protective effects of SMD against IAV-induced lung injury and to elucidate the underlying molecular mechanisms, with particular emphasis on the ZBP1-PANoptosis pathway. METHODS: The protective effects of SMD were evaluated in an IAV-induced lung injury mouse model. The chemical profile and absorbed constituents of SMD were identified using UPLC-MS/MS. Key signaling pathways were predicted through an integrated analysis of network pharmacology and transcriptomics, followed by in silico assessment of the binding potential to ZBP1 using molecular docking and dynamics simulations. To systematically examine the mechanism, specifically the modulation of ZBP1-PANoptosome complex formation and cell death markers, we utilized a series of molecular assays including Western blotting, immunofluorescence, and co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP). RESULTS: SMD treatment significantly ameliorated multiple IAV-induced pathologies, including body weight loss, pulmonary edema, histological injury, and pro-inflammatory cytokine release. Unlike oseltamivir, which significantly reduced infectious viral titers, SMD did not markedly alter viral NP and M mRNA levels or viral titers under these experimental conditions. Nevertheless, SMD substantially improved alveolar barrier function, as demonstrated by reduced BALF protein content and enhanced expression of tight junction (TJ) proteins. Integrated analysis of network pharmacology and transcriptomics revealed significant enrichment of inflammation-, programmed cell death-, apoptosis-, and necroptosis-related pathways, while ZBP1 emerged as a convergent candidate target. Based on the established role of ZBP1 in IAV-induced PANoptosis, ZBP1-mediated PANoptosis signaling was therefore selected as a candidate mechanistic axis for subsequent experimental assessment. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations suggested a potential interaction between ZBP1 and 18beta-glycyrrhetinic acid, a representative serum-absorbed candidate constituent of SMD. Mechanistic investigations revealed that SMD suppressed ZBP1 expression and attenuated downstream activation of pyroptotic, apoptotic, and necroptotic markers. Furthermore, Co-IP and triple-immunofluorescence analyses showed reduced association and colocalization among ZBP1, RIPK3, and Caspase-8, consistent with reduced PANoptosome assembly. CONCLUSION: SMD exerted protective effects against IAV-induced lung injury in association with ZBP1 downregulation, reduced association of PANoptosome-related components, preserved alveolar epithelial barrier function, and dampened inflammatory cascades. This study provides preliminary evidence for the molecular basis of SMD in modulating the ZBP1-PANoptosis pathway, providing scientific rationale for host-directed traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) strategies in severe influenza management.
abstract_zh: 背景：甲型流感病毒（IAV）感染特征性地通过急性炎症和上皮屏障破坏诱导肺损伤。在涉及的致病机制中，Z-DNA结合蛋白1（ZBP1）依赖性PANoptosis发挥核心作用。虽然沙参麦冬汤（SMD）在呼吸系统疾病中显示出临床疗效，但其调节这种特定细胞死亡方式的分子机制仍需进一步阐明。目的：本研究旨在评估SMD对IAV诱导肺损伤的保护作用，并阐明其潜在分子机制，特别关注ZBP1-PANoptosis通路。方法：在IAV诱导的肺损伤小鼠模型中评估SMD的保护作用。使用UPLC-MS/MS鉴定SMD的化学特征和吸收成分。通过网络药理学和转录组学的整合分析预测关键信号通路，随后利用分子对接和动力学模拟进行ZBP1结合潜力的计算机评估。为系统检查机制，特别是ZBP1-PANoptosome复合物形成和细胞死亡标志物的调节，我们使用了一系列分子检测方法，包括Western blotting、免疫荧光和共免疫沉淀（Co-IP）。结果：SMD治疗显著改善了多种IAV诱导的病理变化，包括体重减轻、肺水肿、组织学损伤和促炎细胞因子释放。与显著降低感染性病毒滴度的奥司他韦不同，SMD在这些实验条件下未显著改变病毒NP和M mRNA水平或病毒滴度。然而，SMD显著改善了肺泡屏障功能，表现为BALF蛋白含量降低和紧密连接（TJ）蛋白表达增强。网络药理学和转录组学的整合分析显示炎症、程序性细胞死亡、凋亡和坏死性凋亡相关通路显著富集，而ZBP1作为趋同候选靶点出现。基于ZBP1在IAV诱导PANoptosis中的既定作用，ZBP1介导的PANoptosis信号因此被选为后续实验评估的候选机制轴。分子动力学（MD）模拟提示ZBP1与18β-甘草次酸（SMD的一种代表性血清吸收候选成分）之间存在潜在相互作用。机制研究表明，SMD抑制ZBP1表达并减弱焦亡、凋亡和坏死性凋亡标志物的下游激活。此外，Co-IP和三重免疫荧光分析显示ZBP1、RIPK3和Caspase-8之间的关联和共定位减少，与PANoptosome组装减少一致。结论：SMD对IAV诱导肺损伤发挥保护作用，与ZBP1下调、PANoptosome相关组分关联减少、肺泡上皮屏障功能保持和炎症级联反应抑制相关。本研究为SMD调节ZBP1-PANoptosis通路的分子基础提供了初步证据，为严重流感管理中宿主导向的中医（TCM）策略提供了科学依据。
